SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS time, avg(heart_rate) AS "Heart Rate"
FROM heart_rate_intraday
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND heart_rate > 0
GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', ts)
ORDER BY 1
